title: Eccentric fields: pressure, speed, micro-rotation, w - curl v / 2
caption: Micropolar fluid between eccentric cylinders, eps = 0.6 (rotor axis at x = 0.6 g, rotor turning counter-clockwise at Omega, stator at rest), K = 3, l = 10 dx (m = 5), g = 100 dx, w = 0 on both walls, Ma = 0.02, Re = 10 on mu_inf (25 on mu); every fluid particle at the last step of run `e60_k3_m5` (step 134,000; thesis-ch5-rc2-3-g656e652; Stage 6 run on thesis-ch5-rc2 (numerics.delta_fluid_only: true)). (a) Pressure, mean removed. (b) Speed, with six streamlines started across the widest gap. (c) Micro-rotation. (d) Micro-rotation minus half the curl of the velocity (curl by weighted linear least squares over the fluid neighbours within 3 dx): it vanishes in the core and is carried by the two wall layers of thickness l, where the walls hold w = 0; inset: the narrowest gap (4 l wide). Ranges: pressure -2.88 to 2.84 rho U^2; micro-rotation -4.82 to 0.54 Omega; w - curl v / 2 -0.84 to 7.77 Omega, with a median magnitude of 3.3e-03 Omega further than 5 l from both walls. Colour scales of the signed fields are symmetric about zero and end at the 99.8th percentile of the magnitude.
